tokenFile.label: Phoenix Token File
tokenFile.help: Path to a bearer token file (fallback: PHOENIX_TOKEN_FILE). Prefer this over embedding token values in config.

sealKeyFile.label: Phoenix Seal Key File
sealKeyFile.help: Path to the agent's persistent X25519 seal private key file (fallback: PHOENIX_SEAL_KEY). Required when sealMode is enabled.

caCert.label: CA Certificate Path
caCert.help: Optional CA certificate path for custom TLS trust (fallback: PHOENIX_CA_CERT).

clientCert.label: Client Certificate Path
clientCert.help: Optional client certificate path for mTLS (fallback: PHOENIX_CLIENT_CERT).

clientKey.label: Client Key Path
clientKey.help: Optional client key path for mTLS (fallback: PHOENIX_CLIENT_KEY).

defaultNamespace.label: Default Namespace
defaultNamespace.help: Namespace used when callers pass bare secret ids instead of full phoenix:// refs.

sealMode.label: Sealed Mode
sealMode.help: Return opaque PHOENIX_SEALED tokens instead of plaintext values.
